app-templates.message:
feat(explainer): every exercise's task number in the address; a tutor button on every page

## Intent

A tutor in a chat could not fetch a page's tutor file, and it did not know which tasks the learner had on screen. It should get the current tasks with the right values without fetching anything. The task numbers in the address also serve deep links and sharing the same tasks in class.

## Key changes

- The address holds one parameter per exercise (?<id>=<n>), written on load and at each "Neue Aufgabe". A copied link opens exactly these tasks. ?seed=<n>#<id> still works.
- seed and von are reserved exercise ids; the build stops with one line when an exercise uses them.
- The start page and the end of every page offer one button with a select beside it: the assistants, Claude first, and "Prompt kopieren". A chosen way is kept on the device through the storage wrapper and is selected again after a reload. Without JavaScript the plain links stay.
- On a page the prompt carries the page's address and, taken from its tutor file, the tasks, solutions and typical mistakes of the numbers in the address.
- The tutor files say what to do when a file cannot be fetched.
- The tutor section comes after main, so the page's outline stays its own.
- The e2e tests read each exercise's own parameter, and a new test checks the address, the button and the kept way.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling describes the address and pins this version in the same intent.
- An app that keeps the tutor way on the device now stores something; its catalog entry must say so (i170).

tooling.message:
feat: every exercise's task number in the address; tutor button (pin app-templates dc4a7c2)

## Intent

New and updated apps should get the task numbers in the address and the tutor button on every page, and the assistant should know how they work.

## Key changes

- Apps get app-templates#30: one address parameter per exercise, and on every page the tutor button with a select of assistants, Claude first, whose prompt carries the tasks of the address.
- The explainer skill describes the address format and the button, and warns that a shared link shows other tasks once a generator changes.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Pins the app-templates commits of this intent.
